setup: You are finding the smallest number that both [[a]] and [[b]] divide into exactly.

steps.say: The LCM is a multiple of [[a]] and a multiple of [[b]], so it has to be at least as large as each.
There is a shortcut: LCM = ([[a]] × [[b]]) ÷ GCF. The two numbers share a factor of [[gcd]], which is counted twice unless it is divided back out once.

answer: The least common multiple of [[a]] and [[b]] is [[lcm]].
